# SRFI-64

`srfi-64.scm` is the MIT-licensed reference implementation from https://srfi.schemers.org/srfi-64/testing.scm, retrieved on 2026-11-25. The upstream copyright and license are preserved in the file. TP loads this source only during tests. Browser callbacks and the LIPS `test-error` macro compatibility adjustment live in `../scheme-test-runtime.ts`; the vendor source is unchanged. No log files are created.
